_read_this: UnlockEngrams — one chat command that unlocks every building and crafting
knowledge for whoever types it.
command     what the player types. It has to start with ! — Conan's client
swallows /command locally and never sends it to the server.
permission  empty = anybody can use it. With a Permission node (say
"engrams.use") only players holding that node get through —
and if ConanPermission.dll is not installed, NOBODY does, on
purpose: opening it to everyone because a dependency is
missing would be the opposite of what you asked for here.
The four messages are what the player reads. Change them freely — this is
also where you translate the plugin, without touching a line of code.
{n} becomes how many knowledges this run actually granted — counted one by
one and confirmed with the game afterwards, not guessed. Somebody who
already had everything sees 0, and that is correct. Leave {n} out and the
message is used exactly as written.
msg_partial exists because knowledge in Conan is two things: the feat tree
and the recipes. If only one of them gets unlocked, saying "done" is a lie
in one direction and "failed" a lie in the other — the player would find
out which by walking to a bench. The reason goes to ConanApi.log.
TWO SWITCHES, BOTH OFF BY DEFAULT, and they are separate on purpose.
unlock_dlc     the expansion packs — Siptah, Aquilonia, Yamatai, Pict,
Khitai, Riders, BAS, Argos, RPpack, Riddle, EARhino.
The FeatTable carries every DLC's feats, and the game
refuses the ones the account does not own; that refusal is
the game working, and {dlc} in your message says so.
true steps over it. Measured on a live server: 1332
refusals dropped to 1099, twelve packages gave way whole.
unlock_bazaar  Bazaar and Battle Pass content (the DLC_Special and
DLC_Entitlement rows — 1095 and 4 of those refusals).
This is seasonal store content, not an expansion anyone
could have bought once. It is a DIFFERENT decision from
the one above, so it is a different switch: bundling them
would take the choice away by hiding it.
Both are OFF unless you write them down, and the log prints which way
each one is set on every start — so a typo shows up there instead of in
a player asking why nothing changed.
Whether either one is appropriate on your server is your call, not this
plugin's. It ships neutral.
msg_ok: Unlocked {n} knowledges. Still locked by DLC: {dlc}.
msg_denied: You are not allowed to use this command.
msg_partial: Unlocked {n} knowledges, but not all of it. If something still won't build, tell an admin: the reason is in ConanApi.log.
msg_failed: I could not unlock the knowledge. Tell an admin: the reason is in ConanApi.log.
